artifacts.name: Accounts — Book of Business
artifacts.description: Your Salesforce accounts as a live, refreshable table — industry, owner, location and annual revenue. Refresh re-runs against your own Salesforce: SELECT Name, Industry, AnnualRevenue, NumberOfEmployees, BillingCity, BillingState, Owner.Name FROM Account ORDER BY AnnualRevenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

artifacts.name: Activities — Tasks & Meetings
artifacts.description: Your open Salesforce tasks as a live, refreshable table — due date, type, status, who, what and owner. Refresh re-runs against your own Salesforce: SELECT Subject, ActivityDate, Type, Status, Priority, Who.Name, What.Name, Owner.Name FROM Task WHERE IsClosed = false ORDER BY ActivityDate ASC LIMIT 200

artifacts.name: Cases — Support Queue
artifacts.description: Your open Salesforce cases as a live, refreshable table — subject, status, priority, account and owner. Refresh re-runs against your own Salesforce: SELECT CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Priority, Account.Name, Owner.Name FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 200

artifacts.name: Contacts — People
artifacts.description: Your Salesforce contacts as a live, refreshable table — account, title, email, phone and owner. Refresh re-runs against your own Salesforce: SELECT Name, Account.Name, Title, Email, Phone, Owner.Name FROM Contact ORDER BY LastActivityDate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

artifacts.name: Leads — Inbound Prospects
artifacts.description: Your open Salesforce leads as a live, refreshable table — company, title, status, source, rating and owner. Refresh re-runs against your own Salesforce: SELECT Name, Company, Title, Status, LeadSource, Rating, Owner.Name FROM Lead WHERE IsConverted = false ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 200

artifacts.name: Pipeline — Open Deals
artifacts.description: Your open Salesforce opportunities as a live, refreshable table — stage, amount, close date, probability and owner. Refresh re-runs against your own Salesforce: SELECT Name, Account.Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, Probability, Owner.Name FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false ORDER BY CloseDate ASC LIMIT 200
